resources.string: Couldn\'t reach %1$s.
Tailscale is off on this phone. Turn it on, then try again.

This phone can\'t reach “%1$s”. Open Tailscale on this phone and sign in with the same account as the computer. If Private DNS shows a provider name, set it to Off or Automatic (Settings → Network & internet).
The internet address did not answer either. Check that the computer is on.
Android blocked this app from your local network. Allow local network access for it in the phone\'s Settings, then try again.
Make sure the computer is awake with Seira open, then try again.
Your phone couldn\'t reach %1$s over Tailscale. Turn on Tailscale on this phone, signed in to the same tailnet as the computer, then try again.

Your phone couldn\'t reach %1$s on this network. Put the phone on the same Wi-Fi as the computer. If it already is, the computer\'s firewall may be blocking Seira: on a Windows PC, set its network to Private. Or open Settings → Remote access on the computer and sign in so the phone can connect from anywhere.
“%1$s” didn\'t resolve. If that\'s a Tailscale name, this phone may not be on the tailnet.
